style.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal-blue #10151C for drama and CTA shots, seamless white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust shots, muted warm beige #D8CBBB for lifestyle scenes; clean studio depth, no busy textures
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons, single accent color, rounded label chips
style.lightingSystem: two controlled modes: bright even high-key studio light with soft contact shadows for white shots, dramatic low-key with rim light and controlled speculars for dark shots; light direction always declared
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium kitchen appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal-blue background #10151C, clean white #FFFFFF, muted warm beige #D8CBBB and one signal-red accent #C0272D; neutral tone; brushed stainless steel rendered with controlled highlights and soft contact shadows; bright even high-key lighting for white shots and dramatic low-key lighting with rim light for dark shots; modern geometric sans-serif headline type, white #FFFFFF on dark shots and charcoal #2D2D2D on light shots; consistent thin-line icons and rounded label chips; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; stable centered product presentation and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no fake brand marks.
style.presentationRules: stable centered product presentation, consistent product scale across the set, brushed steel rendered with controlled highlights, no warping of straight lines, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: dark reflective studio ground, matte light surfaces for infographics, light oak-toned tabletop for scenes
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type in #FFFFFF on dark shots and #2D2D2D on light shots
